ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 70% high-intensity (white) to 30% low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity black borders along the trailing edges and lower lateral margins; high-intensity white central lobe regions; discrete black mottling clusters at the medial-superior notch region and upper-distal quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; approximately 40-45 degree convergence angle; vertical pixel depth approximately 12% of the visible vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge; pixel amplitude variations between 2-10 pixels; highest density of irregular peaks located at the distal lobe terminals.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory along the visible lower lateral margins leading to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast brown/yellow pixel clusters at the extreme distal points of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel tracks (rake marks) cutting across high-intensity regions; notable parallel grouping on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple parallel rake mark scars on ventral surface; distal tip barnacle clusters.
